adopted_by: Claude (Mongo Brain) with explicit owner approval (James, chat 2026-10-22 ~09:40 ET: 'All five')
isolation_note: These are process lessons James asked to carry over from his other league. No other league's players, decisions, prices or metrics are stored here; Mongo sample sizes start at 0 and are measured from Mongo outcomes only.

changes.old_rule: Start/sit and FLEX advice could compare two named players.
changes.new_rule: Every start/sit or FLEX recommendation ranks ALL eligible Mongo players (starters and bench) for the open slots with this week's projection from at least one source (ESPN league-scored preferred) and names the full set of starters.
changes.reason: Owner-approved process transfer: head-to-head duels repeatedly missed the best available option.
changes.expected_effect: Fewer points left on the bench; measured by weekly lineup efficiency.

changes.old_rule: Waiver bids were set from generic FAAB guidance.
changes.new_rule: Anchor each bid to Mongo's own clearing prices (intelligence/faab_market.md: winning bids by position, runner-up gaps, rivals' remaining budgets) and to James's remaining FAAB. If the anchored price is not worth it, say 'pass' rather than a token bid. Use $0 free-agent adds when ESPN lists the player as FREEAGENT. Keep a reserve for a starter injury.
changes.reason: Owner-approved process transfer: below-market bids lost and token bids added churn.
changes.expected_effect: Higher claim win rate per dollar; measured by FAAB_OVERPAY / FAAB_UNDERBID review counts.

changes.old_rule: Roster advice could be issued from the newest repository record even if days old.
changes.new_rule: Roster, IR, add/drop and lineup advice requires roster evidence under 24 hours old (ESPN API snapshot, Mongo Live Check, or James's screenshot). If intelligence/reconcile/latest.md shows NEEDS_INGEST, advise from ESPN state and say the repository is behind. If no fresh evidence exists, the first line asks for an ESPN Team-page screenshot and advice is marked 'pending roster check'.
changes.reason: Owner-approved process transfer: stale-roster advice recommended moves on players already dropped.

changes.old_rule: Restatements, watches and confirmations could be logged as DECISIONs.
changes.new_rule: Log a DECISION only for a new or changed recommendation. Restatements, no-action watches and confirmations are not DECISIONs; a changed call names the DECISION it supersedes.
changes.reason: Owner-approved process transfer: restatements polluted confidence calibration.
